spec: Fail-closed benchmark state machine for the 5-shot gate-12 test. Enforced by EXISTING modules (no parallel pipeline): production-runner requireAuth + film-pipeline BudgetLedger + prompt-register thresholds. No paid call occurs until AUTHORIZED; all accounting is ODG-side and pre-call.

states.invariant: no paid provider call possible; requireAuth('paidGeneration') returns BLOCKED by default
states.next: AUTHORIZED (only on explicit gate-12 grant + provider key)

states.invariant: ledger armed at the explicitly authorized ceiling (≤ the amount granted); 0 spent
pre-call ledger check: projected cumulative spend ≤ ceiling, else HARD_STOP; attempt count ≤ 8
record attempt cost, cumulative spend, sha256(file), measured usable duration, cost-per-usable-second; persist evidence
identity ≥4/5, continuity ok, (human ≥7.5/10 recorded only if a real human reviewed)
defect classified; retry goes THROUGH the ledger (no bypass)
attempt+1 ≤ 8; each retry re-checks the ledger before any paid call

states.on: ceiling reached OR 8 attempts OR unfixable eliminatory defect
states.invariant: no further paid call; stop immediately; evidence persisted

invariants: No paid call before an explicit financial authorization (NOT the €250 ceiling, which is a cap not a grant).
Per-attempt AND cumulative spend accounted BEFORE each call; BudgetLedger refuses any crossing spend.
Hard stop at exactly the explicitly authorized amount.
Maximum 8 attempts per shot; no retry bypasses the ledger.
Persist: evidence, file hashes, measured usable duration, cost-per-usable-second, acceptance decisions.
A human-review score is recorded ONLY if a real human reviewed; never synthesized.
60:00±120s is UNPROVEN until a real exported file is measured.

providerEnforcementCaveat.note: If a provider API cannot technically guarantee/enforce a per-call hard stop at the authorized amount (e.g. async batches, prepaid non-refundable credit, no mid-batch cancel), the provider-side enforcement gate is BLOCKED. Enforcement is then ODG-side ONLY: a pre-call ledger gate that refuses to issue the next call once the projected cumulative would cross the ceiling. Prepaid-credit providers (e.g. MiniMax $1,000 min) are INELIGIBLE for a €250-capped test; prefer true pay-as-you-go / small-credit providers.
